description: Figure 1 is a donut-style pie chart showing the distribution of content types in the DODa, with 6 slices corresponding to the legend categories: Moroccan Names (dark blue), Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy) (orange), Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives) (yellow), Translated Sentences (light blue), Lexical & Specialized Data (green), and Pending Translations (purple). The largest slice is the yellow Syntactic Roles segment at approximately 45,387, followed by the green Lexical & Specialized Data segment at about 43,000, then the light-blue Translated Sentences segment at about 30,000, and the orange Semantic Categories segment at about 23,108; two very small slices appear for Moroccan Names (dark blue) and Pending Translations (purple), each visually much smaller than the others (single-digit percentages by appearance). Numeric labels are shown inside the larger slices, a legend is present to the right of the chart, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized; the slices appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller around the ring, with the two smallest adjacent near the top.
